name: WF-256 — Offer Delivery Receipt → Seller Response / Timeout Controller

parameters.jsCode: const d=$json.body??$json;const lead_id=d.lead_id??null,deal_id=d.deal_id??null,property_id=d.property_id??null;const dispatch_id=String(d.dispatch_id??"").trim();const delivery=String(d.delivery_status??d.status??"").toLowerCase();const seller_response=String(d.seller_response??d.response_status??"").toLowerCase();const timeout=Boolean(d.timeout??false);let state="receipt_pending",reason="Delivery receipt requires reconciliation.",next="WF-255";if(!lead_id||!deal_id||!property_id||!dispatch_id){state="blocked";reason="Missing lead, deal, property, or dispatch identity.";next="WF-126";}else if(["delivered","sent","accepted_by_provider"].includes(delivery)&&seller_response==="response_received"){state="response_received";reason="Offer delivered and seller response received.";next="WF-257";}else if(["delivered","sent","accepted_by_provider"].includes(delivery)&&timeout){state="response_timeout";reason="Offer delivery succeeded but seller response timed out.";next="WF-258";}else if(["delivered","sent","accepted_by_provider"].includes(delivery)){state="awaiting_seller_response";reason="Offer delivered; awaiting seller response.";next="WF-258";}else if(["failed","undelivered","rejected"].includes(delivery)){state="delivery_failed";reason="Offer delivery failed or was rejected by provider.";next="WF-255";}else{state="receipt_pending";reason="No definitive delivery receipt is available.";next="WF-255";}return[{json:{workflow:"WF-256",lead_id,deal_id,property_id,dispatch_id,delivery_status:delivery,seller_response_status:seller_response,timeout,state,reason,requires_human_review:state==="delivery_failed"||state==="blocked",next_workflow:next,response_route:state==="response_received"?"seller_response":state==="response_timeout"?"timeout":state==="awaiting_seller_response"?"awaiting_response":"delivery_recovery"}}];
